scope: Completed DEVELOPMENT outcomes only. No holdout model outcomes, replays, prototypes, or new inference are used.
ranking_rule: Original frozen guarded native publications descending over24 distinct development cases.
All actual Luna repair+investigation calls ascending, including failed calls.
Measured total trial latency ascending (descriptive/confounded by native compilation, concurrent scheduling, and cache state).
Lexicographic arm ID only on an exact final tie.
semantic_review_role: Eligibility requires completed independent review. Confirmed semantic false greens are reported alongside original scores; they are not subtracted or silently regraded. V6 uses stronger versioned native guards for fresh confirmation.
